mapper.select: SELECT VM.MTH_NM , V.VACNTN_ICTSD , MAX(V.VACNTN_ODR) AS VACNTN_ODR , MAX(V.VACNTN_NO) AS VACNTN_NO , MAX(VR.CRT_DT) AS CRT_DT FROM vacntn_rcord VR LEFT OUTER JOIN vacntn V ON V.VACNTN_NO = VR.VACNTN_NO LEFT OUTER JOIN vacntn_mth VM ON VM.VACNTN_MTH_NO = V.VACNTN_MTH_NO WHERE VR.CHLDRN_NO = #{chldrnNo} GROUP BY VM.MTH_NM, V.VACNTN_ICTSD
